title: John Lennon and Yoko Ono attend Ms magazine party | 1973
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono attended a Ms magazine party in New York City on 26 June 1973.

It was the publication’s first anniversary party, held on board Ms Liberty, a Circle Line tour boat on the Hudson River. Entertainment was provided by female rock group The Godmothers.
